# Top Level

This layer manages linting and tests for the project.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`.lintstagedrc.js`](../.lintstagedrc.js) | Configures ESLint for staged files. |  |
| [`setupTests.ts`](../setupTests.ts) | Sets up tests for the project. |  |
| [`vitest.config.mts`](../vitest.config.mts) | Configures Vitest for testing. | `default` |

## How it works

- `.lintstagedrc.js` configures ESLint to run on staged files.
- `vitest.config.mts` configures Vitest, a testing framework, for the project.

## Configuration

- Environment variables: `VITE_DEBUG_DOM`.
- Configuration files: `.eslintrc.json`, `.npmrc`, `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`, `tsconfig.json`, `vitest.config.mts`.
